e.body:
**WFII（World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries，世界保险中介人联盟）** 是**全球保险中介业的伞状组织**，站点实测地址为 **Avenue Albert-Elisabeth 40, 1200 Bruxelles, Belgium（布鲁塞尔）**。本条目补的是**「中介业的全球行业组织」这一形态**：**池内中介侧此前是「一家家中介公司」与「辖区监管」，缺「全球中介业自身的组织与立场」这一层**。

可核实信息（**均 HTTP 200 实测**）：首页标题实测 **「Home | World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries (WFII)」**；⭐ **「Members（成员）」页 `/members` 实测 447.0KB（本站体量最大的页面）**；⭐ **「Key issues and positions（核心议题与立场）」页 `/key-issues` 实测 445.6KB，标题「Key issues and positions」**；⭐ **「Insurance Intermediaries（保险中介）」页 `/insurance-intermediaries` 实测 422.9KB**；⭐ **「Who are they?（他们是谁？）」页 `/who-are-they` 实测 397.7KB**；⭐ **「Captives（专属保险公司）」页 `/captives` 实测 393.8KB**；**「Structure（结构）」页 `/structure` 实测 404.2KB**；**「About」页 `/about` 实测 389.1KB**。**导航逐字实测揭示的内容分组**：**Key issues and positions** 下含 **Regulation（监管）**、**Liberalisation（自由化）**、**Multinational placements（跨国投保）**、**Remuneration（报酬）**、**Transparency（透明度）**、**Education（教育）**、**Microinsurance（微型保险）**；**Insurance Intermediaries** 下含 **Who are they?**、**Their role（其角色）**、**In practice（实务中）**、**Risk management（风险管理）**、**Captives**；另有 **Objectives**、**Working principles**、**Links**。

对 RIAA：**① 补上「中介业的全球组织」这一层**——池内**中介「公司」**（[[marsh]]、[[howden]]、[[miller-insurance]]、[[pacific-prime]]、[[guy-carpenter]] 等）与**辖区监管**（[[eiopa-registers]]、[[fca-open-data]]、[[hk-ia-statistics]]）都已有人覆盖，**但「中介业自己如何组织、如何对外表态」此前没有**；**这与 [[aae]]（精算职业的欧洲伞状组织）、[[insurance-europe]]（保险业的欧洲伞状组织）构成三层行业组织的对照**——**一个代表中介、一个代表精算师、一个代表保险公司**。**② ⭐ 「Insurance Intermediaries: Who are they? / Their role / In practice」是一套现成的从业解释材料**——**对刚入行或转行的学生，这是把「中介到底做什么」讲清楚的一组页面**（**注意：本次只核实了页面存在与体量，未打开正文，故不转述其具体论述**）；可与池内 [[insurance-broker]]（中介岗位）、[[mga-actuarial-survey]]（MGA 形态）并读。**③ ⭐ 「Captives（专属保险公司）」是一个此前池内没有的形态**——**专属保险公司是企业为自保而设的保险公司**，**与商业保险、再保险并列为第三种风险融资方式**；**WFII 把它放在中介议题下讲解**，**这一点本身反映了一个制度事实：专属保险的设立与运行高度依赖中介与顾问服务**。**④ 议题清单是「中介业与监管的摩擦面」的现成列表**——**报酬（Remuneration）、透明度（Transparency）、跨国投保（Multinational placements）** 三项都是中介监管中最常引发争议的题目；**对做保险分销监管比较的学生，这份议题清单可直接当作分析框架的起点**。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**①** 本次核实到**首页与六个功能页的存在、标题、页面体量、以及导航逐字实测出的议题与内容分组**，**但未打开任何一页的正文内容**（**上述「页面讲什么」均为依据标题与分组的合理描述，未转述具体论述**），因此**不能转述 WFII 对任何议题的具体立场、成员协会名单或其结构细节**；**② 站点为 Wix 建站（页脚实测含 ©2018 与「PRIVACY POLICY HERE」）**，**内容主要在子页面且 About 页正文本身很薄（实测仅有小标题列表）**——**这一点已在词条中体现（标题与摘要依据功能页而非 About 页）**；**③ 我猜测的 `/key-issues-and-positions` 路径实测 404**（**真实路径为 `/key-issues`**）——**又一次「不要猜路径、从导航反查」**；**④ 成员协会的具体数量与构成本次未核实**（**`/members` 页体量 447.0KB 为实测值，但其中多少是名单、多少是页面框架未区分**）；**⑤ WFII 的法定地位（是否为行业自律组织）、其与各国中介协会的关系本次未核实**；**⑥** 本词条**不主张** WFII 提供数据下载、统计或精算工具。**核实说明**：首页（200）、`/about`（389.1KB）、`/members`（447.0KB）、`/key-issues`（445.6KB）、`/insurance-intermediaries`（422.9KB）、`/who-are-they`（397.7KB）、`/captives`（393.8KB）、`/structure`（404.2KB）均 HTTP 200 实测并逐字读取导航分组；**未打开任何页面正文**；`/key-issues-and-positions` 实测 404（猜错路径）。

e.body_en:
**WFII (the World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries)** is **the global umbrella body of the insurance intermediary industry**, with a measured site address of **Avenue Albert-Elisabeth 40, 1200 Bruxelles, Belgium**. This entry adds the **"global trade body of the intermediary industry"** form: the corpus’s intermediary side previously held **individual intermediary firms and jurisdictional supervision, but no layer for how the intermediary industry organises and positions itself globally**.

Verifiable details (**all measured HTTP 200**): the homepage title reads **"Home | World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries (WFII)"**; ⭐ the **"Members" page `/members` measures 447.0KB (the largest page on the site)**; ⭐ the **"Key issues and positions" page `/key-issues` measures 445.6KB with the title "Key issues and positions"**; ⭐ the **"Insurance Intermediaries" page `/insurance-intermediaries` measures 422.9KB**; ⭐ the **"Who are they?" page `/who-are-they` measures 397.7KB**; ⭐ the **"Captives" page `/captives` measures 393.8KB**; the **"Structure" page `/structure` measures 404.2KB**; the **"About" page measures 389.1KB**. **Navigation read verbatim reveals the content groupings**: under **Key issues and positions** — **Regulation**, **Liberalisation**, **Multinational placements**, **Remuneration**, **Transparency**, **Education** and **Microinsurance**; under **Insurance Intermediaries** — **Who are they?**, **Their role**, **In practice**, **Risk management** and **Captives**; plus **Objectives**, **Working principles** and **Links**.

For RIAA: **① it adds the "global organisation of the intermediary industry"** — the corpus already covers **intermediary firms** ([[marsh]], [[howden]], [[miller-insurance]], [[pacific-prime]], [[guy-carpenter]] and others) and **jurisdictional supervision** ([[eiopa-registers]], [[fca-open-data]], [[hk-ia-statistics]]), **but "how the intermediary industry organises itself and what it says publicly" was absent**; this contrasts with [[aae]] (the European umbrella for the actuarial profession) and [[insurance-europe]] (the European umbrella for insurers) — **one representing intermediaries, one actuaries, one insurers**. **② ⭐ "Insurance Intermediaries: Who are they? / Their role / In practice" is a ready-made explaining set** — **for students entering or transitioning into the field, this is a group of pages that sets out what intermediaries actually do** (**note: this check confirmed only page existence and size, opened no body text, and so restates no specific argument**); readable with [[insurance-broker]] (the job) and [[mga-actuarial-survey]] (the MGA form). **③ ⭐ "Captives" is a form the corpus did not have** — **a captive is an insurer a company sets up to insure itself**, **standing alongside commercial insurance and reinsurance as a third way of financing risk**; **WFII places it under intermediary topics**, **which itself reflects an institutional fact: setting up and running a captive depends heavily on intermediary and advisory services**. **④ The topics list is a ready inventory of the friction points between intermediaries and regulators** — **Remuneration, Transparency and Multinational placements** are among the most contested subjects in intermediary regulation; **for comparative work on insurance distribution regulation, this list can serve directly as a starting analytical frame**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **①** this check verified **the existence, titles and page sizes of the homepage and six functional pages, plus the topic and content groupings read verbatim from navigation**, **but opened no page body** (**so "what the page discusses" above is a reasonable description from titles and groupings, with no specific argument restated**), and therefore **WFII’s positions on any topic, its member-association list and its structural details cannot be restated**; **② the site is built on Wix (the footer measurably carries ©2018 and "PRIVACY POLICY HERE")**, and **content sits in subpages with the About page body itself thin (measurably only a list of subheadings)** — **reflected in this entry by resting its title and summary on the functional pages rather than About**; **③ my guessed path `/key-issues-and-positions` measured 404** (**the real path is `/key-issues`**) — **another "do not guess paths; read the navigation"**; **④ the number and composition of member associations were not verified** (**the 447.0KB `/members` page size is measured, but content versus page frame was not distinguished**); **⑤ WFII’s legal status (whether it is a self-regulatory body) and its relationship with national intermediary associations were not verified**; **⑥** this entry **does not claim WFII provides data downloads, statistics or actuarial tools**. **Verification note**: the homepage (200), `/about` (389.1KB), `/members` (447.0KB), `/key-issues` (445.6KB), `/insurance-intermediaries` (422.9KB), `/who-are-they` (397.7KB), `/captives` (393.8KB) and `/structure` (404.2KB) were measured at HTTP 200 with navigation groupings read verbatim; **no page body was opened**; `/key-issues-and-positions` measured 404 (guessed path).

e.body_hk:
**WFII（World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries，世界保險中介人聯盟）** 是**全球保險中介業的傘狀組織**，站點實測地址為 **Avenue Albert-Elisabeth 40, 1200 Bruxelles, Belgium（布魯塞爾）**。本條目補的是**「中介業的全球行業組織」這一形態**：**池內中介側此前是「一家家中介公司」與「轄區監管」，缺「全球中介業自身的組織與立場」**。

可核實資訊（**均 HTTP 200 實測**）：首頁標題實測 **「Home | World Federation of Insurance Intermediaries (WFII)」**；⭐ **「Members」頁 447.0KB（本站體量最大）**；⭐ **「Key issues and positions」頁 445.6KB**；⭐ **「Insurance Intermediaries」頁 422.9KB**；⭐ **「Who are they?」頁 397.7KB**；⭐ **「Captives」頁 393.8KB**；**「Structure」頁 404.2KB**；**「About」頁 389.1KB**。**導航逐字實測分組**：**Key issues and positions** 含 **Regulation／Liberalisation／Multinational placements／Remuneration／Transparency／Education／Microinsurance**；**Insurance Intermediaries** 含 **Who are they?／Their role／In practice／Risk management／Captives**；另有 **Objectives／Working principles／Links**。

對 RIAA：**① 補上「中介業的全球組織」這一層**——池內**中介「公司」**與**轄區監管**都已有人覆蓋，**但「中介業自己如何組織、如何對外表態」此前沒有**；與 [[aae]]（精算職業的歐洲傘狀組織）、[[insurance-europe]]（保險業的歐洲傘狀組織）構成**三層行業組織對照**。**② ⭐ 「Who are they? / Their role / In practice」是現成的從業解釋材料**（**本次僅核實頁面存在與體量，未打開正文，故不轉述其具體論述**）；可與 [[insurance-broker]]、[[mga-actuarial-survey]] 並讀。**③ ⭐ 「Captives（專屬保險公司）」是此前池內沒有的形態**——**企業為自保而設的保險公司**，**與商業保險、再保險並列為第三種風險融資方式**；**WFII 把它放在中介議題下，反映「專屬保險的設立與運行高度依賴中介與顧問服務」這一制度事實**。**④ 議題清單是「中介業與監管摩擦面」的現成列表**——**報酬、透明度、跨國投保**三項都是中介監管中最常引發爭議的題目。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**①** 本次核實到**首頁與六個功能頁的存在、標題、體量、以及導航逐字實測的分組**，**但未打開任何一頁正文**（**上述「頁面講什麼」均為依據標題與分組的合理描述，未轉述具體論述**），故**不能轉述 WFII 對任何議題的具體立場、成員協會名單或結構細節**；**② 站點為 Wix 建站（頁腳實測含 ©2018）**，**About 頁正文本身很薄**——**故本條目標題與摘要依據功能頁**；**③ 我猜測的 `/key-issues-and-positions` 實測 404**（**真實路徑為 `/key-issues`**）；**④ 成員協會的數量與構成未核實**；**⑤ 其法定地位、與各國中介協會的關係未核實**；**⑥** 本詞條**不主張** WFII 提供數據下載、統計或精算工具**。**核實說明**：八個 URL 均 HTTP 200 實測並逐字讀取導航分組；**未打開任何頁面正文**。
